title: relay develops itself with its own plugins and OpenSpec
what: relay's own repo records the plugins relay development uses, and only those, with the OpenSpec spec steps turned on, so relay is the first project that runs relay.
why: Owner, 26 Oct: "Включи openspec plugin для самого relay, зафиксируй только нужное для разработки relay, первым испытателем relay будет сам relay". Facts, 26 Oct: the relay repo has no .claude/ folder; core, delegate, front, observe and gopls-lsp (Go language server; relay has no Go) are on only in ~/.claude/settings.json; issues, openspec and product are not on for relay; relay has no openspec/ folder; openspec 1.14.2 is installed; OpenSpec's `openspec init` writes 4 /opsx commands and 6 openspec-* skills into .claude/. wt/parallel (train-15) adds relay's .claude/kit.toml and wt/openspec-plugin moves the spec rule into the plugin's own hook: build after both merge. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
